headline: President Obama's 2013 order puts into effect sanctions from a 2012 Iran law and adds more economic sanctions on Iran.
what_it_does: This executive order gives federal agencies the authority to carry out certain sanctions written into the Iran Freedom and Counter-Proliferation Act of 2012. It also sets out additional sanctions related to Iran. No summary was provided, so the specific sanctions and who they target are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and banks that deal with Iran
who_it_affects.how: They may face penalties or restrictions under the sanctions this order puts into effect.
They are the main target of the economic sanctions authorized by this order.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies such as the Treasury and State Departments
who_it_affects.how: They are given the authority and duty to carry out the sanctions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 3, 2013; exact effective date not stated in the provided information.
